profile.name: Asadbek Kasymov
profile.intro: I am passionate about creating interfaces that make interacting with websites and applications not only convenient but also enjoyable.
profile.cvTitle: I am an experienced Frontend developer
profile.cvText: Specializing in creating modern and high-performance web applications for B2B and B2C segments. In my projects, I combine aesthetic design, user-friendly interfaces, and reliable functionality to help businesses effectively engage with clients and partners. I have a strong understanding of the needs of different audiences and know how to adapt my solutions to achieve the best results.
profile.workIntro: As a Frontend developer, I specialize in building user interfaces for web applications that prioritize usability and intuitive interactions. I collaborate closely with designers and backend developers to deliver projects from concept to final product.
profile.workflowText: My workflow involves analyzing tasks, developing responsive interfaces, implementing animations, and integrating with APIs. I quickly prototype, test across browsers and devices, and collaborate closely with the team to achieve project goals.
profile.hobbyText: My hobby is cooking. I enjoy experimenting with recipes, trying new cuisines, and combining different ingredients. For me, it is not just a way to relax but also a chance to be creative and make my loved ones happy with delicious meals.
profile.interestsText: I am always fascinated by understanding how things work. I enjoy diving into the details, exploring mechanisms, and figuring out solutions. This curiosity helps me deeply engage with projects, find efficient answers, and continuously improve my skills.

notepad.readme:
Hi! I'm Asadbek — Frontend Developer.

I build modern, fast web applications for B2B and B2C:
interfaces that are not only convenient, but enjoyable to use.

On the desktop
--------------
  About Me       — who I am, what I do, skills and contacts
  Resume.pdf     — my CV
  Projects       — commercial projects I took part in
  Contacts       — GitHub, LinkedIn, Telegram, WhatsApp, email
  This PC        — everything else, see below

This PC
-------
  C:  Pet Projects, My Tools (the stack I use every day),
      Documents and Program Files (Chrome really works)
  D:  the fun part — games, Paint and a file you'd better not open

Stack
-----
React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, SASS, Redux, Zustand,
Axios, i18n, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Git.

Contacts
--------
  Email     bek229101@gmail.com
  WhatsApp  +996 (557) 766 997
  Telegram  @scDjanGo
  GitHub    github.com/scDjanGo
